annotations.title: A vault’s collateral at its real price

description: What a lending vault lends against, at what that collateral actually sells for: each tokenized stock (DEX price against its share on the exchange, live while the exchange is open) and each USD stablecoin (price against $1). Per collateral: exposure in dollars, the gap, the borrowers’ loan-to-value at the token’s price and whether a liquidation at the oracle’s price still pays. A gap is measured, not a loss. FREE.
